info.title: Mattermost
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 33 of 598 upstream operations, covering Channels, Posts, Users, and Teams CRUD and membership management for automation. See the repo README for the full breakdown and the full spec.
info.description: Mattermost is an open-source, self-hostable team collaboration and messaging platform, providing channels, direct messaging, and integrations for engineering and IT operations teams.

get.summary: Get a list of all channels

parameters.name: not_associated_to_group
parameters.description: A group id to exclude channels that are associated with that group via GroupChannel records. This can also be left blank with `not_associated_to_group=`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to select.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The number of channels per page.

parameters.name: exclude_default_channels
parameters.description: Whether to exclude default channels (ex Town Square, Off-Topic) from the results.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Include channels that have been archived. This correlates to the `DeleteAt` flag being set in the database.

parameters.name: include_total_count
parameters.description: Appends a total count of returned channels inside the response object - ex: `{ "channels": [], "total_count" : 0 }`.

parameters.name: exclude_policy_constrained
parameters.description:
If set to true, channels which are part of a data retention policy will be excluded. The `sysconsole_read_compliance` permission is required to use this parameter.

post.description:
Create a new channel.
##### Permissions
If creating a public channel, `create_public_channel` permission is required. If creating a private channel, `create_private_channel` permission is required.

team_id.description: The team ID of the team to create the channel on

name.description: The unique handle for the channel, will be present in the channel URL

display_name.description: The non-unique UI name for the channel

purpose.description: A short description of the purpose of the channel

header.description: Markdown-formatted text to display in the header of the channel

type.description: 'O' for a public channel, 'P' for a private channel

managed_category_name.description: The name of the managed category to assign this channel to. Requires an Enterprise license and the `ManagedChannelCategories` feature flag to be enabled.

default_category_name.description: Default sidebar category name for members when joining this channel. Requires `EnableChannelCategorySorting` to be enabled on the server.

delete.description:
Archives a channel. This will set the `deleteAt` to the current timestamp in the database. Soft deleted channels may not be accessible in the user interface. They can be viewed and unarchived in the **System Console > User Management > Channels** based on your license. Direct and group message channels cannot be deleted.

As of server version 5.28, optionally use the `permanent=true` query parameter to permanently delete the channel for compliance reasons. To use this feature `ServiceSettings.EnableAPIChannelDeletion` must be set to `true` in the server's configuration. If you permanently delete a channel this action is not recoverable outside of a database backup.

##### Permissions
`delete_public_channel` permission if the channel is public,
`delete_private_channel` permission if the channel is private,
or have `manage_system` permission.

parameters.name: channel_id
parameters.description: Channel GUID

post.description:
Create a new post in a channel. To create the post as a comment on another post, provide `root_id`.
##### Permissions
Must have `create_post` permission for the channel the post is being created in.

parameters.name: set_online
parameters.description: Whether to set the user status as online or not.

parameters.name: silent
parameters.description: When `true`, the post is delivered silently: visible in the channel and broadcast over WebSocket, but produces no desktop/push/email notifications, no unread or mention count increments, and no "New Messages" line. Only bot accounts, OAuth apps, incoming webhooks, and plugins may set this; non-integration senders receive HTTP 403. `force_notification` overrides `silent`.

channel_id.description: The channel ID to post in

message.description: The message contents, can be formatted with Markdown

root_id.description: The post ID to comment on

file_ids.description: A list of file IDs to associate with the post. Note that posts are limited to 5 files maximum. Please use additional posts for more files.

props.description: A general JSON property bag to attach to the post

metadata.description: A JSON object to add post metadata, e.g the post's priority

priority.description: An object containing the post's priority properties
The priority label of the post, could empty, important, or urgent

requested_ack.description: Set to true to request for acknowledgements

Get a single post.
##### Permissions

parameters.description: ID of the post to get

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Defines if result should include deleted posts, must have 'manage_system' (admin) permission.

Has-Inaccessible-Posts.description: This header is included with the value "true" if the post is past the cloud's plan limit.

put.description:
Update a post. Only the fields listed below are updatable, omitted fields will be treated as blank.

parameters.name: post_id

is_pinned.description: Set to `true` to pin the post to the channel it is in

message.description: The message text of the post

has_reactions.description: Set to `true` if the post has reactions to it

props.description: A general JSON property bag to attach to the post

parameters.name: post_id

get.description:
Get a page of posts in a channel. Use the query parameters to modify the behaviour of this endpoint. The parameter `since` must not be used with any of `before`, `after`, `page`, and `per_page` parameters.
If `since` is used, it will always return all posts modified since that time, ordered by their create time limited till 1000. A caveat with this parameter is that there is no guarantee that the returned posts will be consecutive. It is left to the clients to maintain state and fill any missing holes in the post order.
##### Permissions
Must have `read_channel` permission for the channel.

parameters.name: channel_id
parameters.description: The channel ID to get the posts for

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to select

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The number of posts per page

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Provide a non-zero value in Unix time milliseconds to select posts modified after that time

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: A post id to select the posts that came before this one

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A post id to select the posts that came after this one

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Whether to include deleted posts or not. Must have system admin permissions.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter posts by type.

post.description:
Search posts visible to the current user across all teams.
##### Permissions
Must be authenticated.

get.description:
Get a page of a list of users. Based on query string parameters, select users from a team, channel, or select users not in a specific channel.
Since server version 4.0, some basic sorting is available using the `sort` query parameter. Sorting is currently only supported when selecting users on a team.
Some fields, like `email_verified` and `notify_props`, are only visible for the authorized user or if the authorized user has the `manage_system` permission.
##### Permissions
Requires an active session and (if specified) membership to the channel or team being selected from.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to select.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The number of users per page.

parameters.name: in_team
parameters.description: The ID of the team to get users for.

parameters.name: not_in_team
parameters.description: The ID of the team to exclude users for. Must not be used with "in_team" query parameter.

parameters.name: in_channel
parameters.description: The ID of the channel to get users for.

parameters.name: not_in_channel
parameters.description: The ID of the channel to exclude users for. Must be used with "in_channel" query parameter.

parameters.name: in_group
parameters.description: The ID of the group to get users for. Must have `manage_system` permission.

parameters.name: group_constrained
parameters.description: When used with `not_in_channel` or `not_in_team`, returns only the users that are allowed to join the channel or team based on its group constrains.

parameters.name: abac_match_only
parameters.description:
When used with `not_in_channel`, restricts the result to users whose attributes satisfy the channel's Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) membership policy.

On private channels with an ABAC policy this filter is always applied regardless of this parameter (hard gate). On public channels with an advisory ABAC policy the full not_in_channel candidate list is returned by default; set this to `true` to fetch only the matching subset of candidates (for example to annotate recommended members in the invite UI).

__Minimum server version__: 11.8

parameters.name: without_team
parameters.description: Whether or not to list users that are not on any team. This option takes precendence over `in_team`, `in_channel`, and `not_in_channel`.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Whether or not to list only users that are active. This option cannot be used along with the `inactive` option.

parameters.name: inactive
parameters.description: Whether or not to list only users that are deactivated. This option cannot be used along with the `active` option.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Returns users that have this role.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort is only available in conjunction with certain options below. The paging parameter is also always available.

##### `in_team`
Can be "", "last_activity_at" or "create_at".
When left blank, sorting is done by username.
Note that when "last_activity_at" is specified, an additional "last_activity_at" field will be returned in the response packet.
__Minimum server version__: 4.0
##### `in_channel`
Can be "", "status".
When left blank, sorting is done by username. `status` will sort by User's current status (Online, Away, DND, Offline), then by Username.
__Minimum server version__: 4.7
##### `in_group`
Can be "", "display_name".
When left blank, sorting is done by username. `display_name` will sort alphabetically by user's display name.
__Minimum server version__: 7.7

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description:
Comma separated string used to filter users based on any of the specified system roles

Example: `?roles=system_admin,system_user` will return users that are either system admins or system users

__Minimum server version__: 5.26

parameters.name: channel_roles
parameters.description:
Comma separated string used to filter users based on any of the specified channel roles, can only be used in conjunction with `in_channel`

Example: `?in_channel=4eb6axxw7fg3je5iyasnfudc5y&channel_roles=channel_user` will return users that are only channel users and not admins or guests

__Minimum server version__: 5.26

parameters.name: team_roles
parameters.description:
Comma separated string used to filter users based on any of the specified team roles, can only be used in conjunction with `in_team`

Example: `?in_team=4eb6axxw7fg3je5iyasnfudc5y&team_roles=team_user` will return users that are only team users and not admins or guests

__Minimum server version__: 5.26

post.description:
Create a new user on the system. Password is required for email login. For other authentication types such as LDAP or SAML, auth_data and auth_service fields are required.
##### Permissions
No permission required for creating email/username accounts on an open server. Auth Token is required for other authentication types such as LDAP or SAML.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Token id from an email invitation

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Token id from an invitation link

auth_data.description: Service-specific authentication data, such as email address.

auth_service.description: The authentication service, one of "email", "gitlab", "ldap", "saml", "office365", "google", and "".

password.description: The password used for email authentication.

Get a user a object. Sensitive information will be sanitized out.
##### Permissions
Requires an active session but no other permissions.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User GUID. This can also be "me" which will point to the current user.

put.description:
Update a user by providing the user object. The fields that can be updated are defined in the request body, all other provided fields will be ignored. Any fields not included in the request body will be set to null or reverted to default values.
##### Permissions
Must be logged in as the user being updated or have the `edit_other_users` permission.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User GUID

requestBody.description: User object that is to be updated

delete.description:
Deactivates the user and revokes all its sessions by archiving its user object.

As of server version 5.28, optionally use the `permanent=true` query parameter to permanently delete the user for compliance reasons. To use this feature `ServiceSettings.EnableAPIUserDeletion` must be set to `true` in the server's configuration.
##### Permissions
Must be logged in as the user being deactivated or have the `edit_other_users` permission.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User GUID

get.description:
Get a user object by providing a username. Sensitive information will be sanitized out.

Requires an active session but no other permissions.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username

get.description:
Get a user object by providing a user email. Sensitive information will be sanitized out.
##### Permissions
Requires an active session and for the current session to be able to view another user's email based on the server's privacy settings.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: User Email

post.description:
Get a list of users based on search criteria provided in the request body. Searches are typically done against username, full name, nickname and email unless otherwise configured by the server.
##### Permissions
Requires an active session and `read_channel` and/or `view_team` permissions for any channels or teams specified in the request body.

term.description: The term to match against username, full name, nickname and email

team_id.description: If provided, only search users on this team

not_in_team_id.description: If provided, only search users not on this team

in_channel_id.description: If provided, only search users in this channel

not_in_channel_id.description: If provided, only search users not in this channel. Must specifiy `team_id` when using this option

in_group_id.description: If provided, only search users in this group. Must have `manage_system` permission.

group_constrained.description: When used with `not_in_channel_id` or `not_in_team_id`, returns only the users that are allowed to join the channel or team based on its group constrains.

allow_inactive.description: When `true`, include deactivated users in the results

without_team.description: Set this to `true` if you would like to search for users that are not on a team. This option takes precendence over `team_id`, `in_channel_id`, and `not_in_channel_id`.

limit.description:
The maximum number of users to return in the results

__Available as of server version 5.6. Defaults to `100` if not provided or on an earlier server version.__

put.description:
Activate or deactivate a user's account. A deactivated user can't log into Mattermost or use it without being reactivated.

__Since server version 4.6, users using a SSO provider to login can be activated or deactivated with this endpoint. However, if their activation status in Mattermost does not reflect their status in the SSO provider, the next synchronization or login by that user will reset the activation status to that of their account in the SSO provider. Server versions 4.5 and before do not allow activation or deactivation of SSO users from this endpoint.__
##### Permissions
User can deactivate themselves.
User with `manage_system` permission can activate or deactivate a user.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User GUID

requestBody.description: Use `true` to activate the user or `false` to deactivate them

parameters.name: exclude_policy_constrained

If set to true, teams which are part of a data retention policy will be excluded. The `sysconsole_read_compliance` permission is required to use this parameter.
__Minimum server version__: 5.35

bearerAuth.description: Static Mattermost Personal Access Token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. No login call is used.

BadRequest.description: Invalid or missing parameters in URL or request body

email.description: Set to "true" to enable email notifications, "false" to disable. Defaults to "true".

push.description: Set to "all" to receive push notifications for all activity, "mention" for mentions and direct messages only, and "none" to disable. Defaults to "mention".

desktop.description: Set to "all" to receive desktop notifications for all activity, "mention" for mentions and direct messages only, and "none" to disable. Defaults to "all".

desktop_sound.description: Set to "true" to enable sound on desktop notifications, "false" to disable. Defaults to "true".

mention_keys.description: A comma-separated list of words to count as mentions. Defaults to username and @username.

channel.description: Set to "true" to enable channel-wide notifications (@channel, @all, etc.), "false" to disable. Defaults to "true".

first_name.description: Set to "true" to enable mentions for first name. Defaults to "true" if a first name is set, "false" otherwise.

auto_responder_message.description: The message sent to users when they are auto-responded to. Defaults to "".

push_threads.description: Set to "all" to enable mobile push notifications for followed threads and "none" to disable. Defaults to "all".

comments.description: Set to "any" to enable notifications for comments to any post you have replied to, "root" for comments on your posts, and "never" to disable. Only affects users with collapsed reply threads disabled. Defaults to "never".

desktop_threads.description: Set to "all" to enable desktop notifications for followed threads and "none" to disable. Defaults to "all".

email_threads.description: Set to "all" to enable email notifications for followed threads and "none" to disable. Defaults to "all".

id.description: The unique identifier for this file

user_id.description: The ID of the user that uploaded this file

post_id.description: If this file is attached to a post, the ID of that post

create_at.description: The time in milliseconds a file was created

update_at.description: The time in milliseconds a file was last updated

delete_at.description: The time in milliseconds a file was deleted

extension.description: The extension at the end of the file name

size.description: The size of the file in bytes

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the file

width.description: If this file is an image, the width of the file

height.description: If this file is an image, the height of the file

has_preview_image.description: If this file is an image, whether or not it has a preview-sized version

create_at.description: The time in milliseconds a channel was created

update_at.description: The time in milliseconds a channel was last updated

delete_at.description: The time in milliseconds a channel was deleted

last_post_at.description: The time in milliseconds of the last post of a channel

matches.description: A mapping of post IDs to a list of matched terms within the post. This field will only be populated on servers running version 5.1 or greater with Elasticsearch enabled.

create_at.description: The time in milliseconds a team was created

update_at.description: The time in milliseconds a team was last updated

delete_at.description: The time in milliseconds a team was deleted

policy_id.description: The data retention policy to which this team has been assigned. If no such policy exists, or the caller does not have the `sysconsole_read_compliance_data_retention` permission, this field will be null.

PostPriority.description: Priority metadata associated with a post or draft.

priority.description: The priority label of a post, either empty, important, or urgent.

requested_ack.description: Whether the post author has requested acknowledgements.

persistent_notifications.description: Whether persistent notifications are enabled for the post.

user_id.description: The ID of the user that made this reaction

post_id.description: The ID of the post to which this reaction was made

emoji_name.description: The name of the emoji that was used for this reaction

create_at.description: The time in milliseconds this reaction was made

creator_id.description: The ID of the user that made the emoji

create_at.description: The time in milliseconds the emoji was made

update_at.description: The time in milliseconds the emoji was last updated

delete_at.description: The time in milliseconds the emoji was deleted

useAutomaticTimezone.description: Set to "true" to use the browser/system timezone, "false" to set manually. Defaults to "true".

manualTimezone.description: Value when setting manually the timezone, i.e. "Europe/Berlin".

automaticTimezone.description: This value is set automatically when the "useAutomaticTimezone" is set to "true".

last_viewed_at.description: The time in milliseconds the channel was last viewed by the user. This field is omitted when the membership belongs to a user other than the requester, as the value is private to that user.

last_update_at.description: The time in milliseconds the channel member was last updated. This field is omitted when the membership belongs to a user other than the requester, as the value is private to that user.

user_id.description: The ID of the user that made this acknowledgement.

post_id.description: The ID of the post to which this acknowledgement was made.

acknowledged_at.description: The time in milliseconds in which this acknowledgement was made.

PostMetadata.description: Additional information used to display a post.

embeds.description: Information about content embedded in the post including OpenGraph previews, image link previews, and message attachments. This field will be null if the post does not contain embedded content.

type.description: The type of content that is embedded in this point.

url.description: The URL of the embedded content, if one exists.

data.description:
Any additional information about the embedded content. Only used at this time to store OpenGraph metadata.
This field will be null for non-OpenGraph embeds.

emojis.description: The custom emojis that appear in this point or have been used in reactions to this post. This field will be null if the post does not contain custom emojis.

files.description: The FileInfo objects for any files attached to the post. This field will be null if the post does not have any file attachments.

images.description: An object mapping the URL of an external image to an object containing the dimensions of that image. This field will be null if the post or its embedded content does not reference any external images.

reactions.description: Any reactions made to this point. This field will be null if no reactions have been made to this post.

priority.description: Post priority set for this post. This field will be null if no priority metadata has been set.

acknowledgements.description: Any acknowledgements made to this point.

email.description: Set to "true" to enable email notifications, "false" to disable, or "default" to use the global user notification setting.

push.description: Set to "all" to receive push notifications for all activity, "mention" for mentions and direct messages only, "none" to disable, or "default" to use the global user notification setting.

desktop.description: Set to "all" to receive desktop notifications for all activity, "mention" for mentions and direct messages only, "none" to disable, or "default" to use the global user notification setting.

mark_unread.description: Set to "all" to mark the channel unread for any new message, "mention" to mark unread for new mentions only. Defaults to "all".

next_post_id.description: The ID of next post. Not omitted when empty or not relevant.

prev_post_id.description: The ID of previous post. Not omitted when empty or not relevant.

has_next.description: Whether there are more items after this page.

status.description: Will contain "ok" if the request was successful and there was nothing else to return

team_id.description: The ID of the team this member belongs to.

user_id.description: The ID of the user this member relates to.

roles.description: The complete list of roles assigned to this team member, as a space-separated list of role names, including any roles granted implicitly through permissions schemes.

delete_at.description: The time in milliseconds that this team member was deleted.

scheme_user.description: Whether this team member holds the default user role defined by the team's permissions scheme.

scheme_admin.description: Whether this team member holds the default admin role defined by the team's permissions scheme.

explicit_roles.description: The list of roles explicitly assigned to this team member, as a space separated list of role names. This list does *not* include any roles granted implicitly through permissions schemes.

team_display_name.description: The display name of the team to which this channel belongs.

team_name.description: The name of the team to which this channel belongs.

team_update_at.description: The time at which the team to which this channel belongs was last updated.

policy_id.description: The data retention policy to which this team has been assigned. If no such policy exists, or the caller does not have the `sysconsole_read_compliance_data_retention` permission, this field will be null.

create_at.description: The time in milliseconds a post was created

update_at.description: The time in milliseconds a post was last updated

delete_at.description: The time in milliseconds a post was deleted

create_at.description: The time in milliseconds a user was created

update_at.description: The time in milliseconds a user was last updated

delete_at.description: The time in milliseconds a user was deleted

terms_of_service_id.description: ID of accepted terms of service, if any. This field is not present if empty.

terms_of_service_create_at.description: The time in milliseconds the user accepted the terms of service
